title: System overview diagrams (SVG)
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. Readers need clear diagrams of the product family, load path, and connector and anchor arrangement.
objective: Produce scripted or hand-authored SVG diagrams: product family, load path (belt → tethers → anchors → seat structure), RAS-2 vs RAS-3 layouts, and center-strap modes.
acceptanceCriteria: SVGs readable in light and dark themes
Every diagram labelled DRAFT and consistent with concepts.md
